d: We are seeking a highly professional and customer-focused Luxury Brand Manager / Luxury Client Advisor to lead brand development, luxury sales, and premium customer relationship management. The successful candidate will be responsible for strengthening brand positioning, delivering personalised luxury experiences, developing high-value client relationships, and driving business growth while maintaining the highest standards of brand excellence, discretion, and customer service.
Develop and implement luxury brand strategies to strengthen market positioning and brand reputation.
Manage daily brand operations and ensure consistent delivery of luxury service standards.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), VIP clients, and premium customers.
Provide personalised consultations, product recommendations, and exclusive shopping experiences.
Drive sales performance, achieve revenue targets, and identify new business opportunities.
Manage VIP client portfolios, customer databases, and clienteling activities.
Organise private appointments, exclusive events, product launches, and VIP engagement programmes.
Monitor luxury market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences.
Ensure product presentation, visual merchandising, and brand image meet established standards.
Handle customer enquiries, feedback, and complaints with professionalism and discretion.
Coordinate with marketing, sales, operations, and regional brand management teams.
Analyse sales performance, customer insights, and business opportunities to support strategic decisions.
Develop client retention strategies and strengthen customer loyalty.
Lead, coach, and motivate sales teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences (for managerial positions).
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Luxury Brand Management, Fashion, Retail Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in luxury retail, premium sales, brand management, or customer relationship management.
Previous experience with luxury fashion, jewellery, watches, beauty, automotive, hospitality, or premium lifestyle brands is preferred.
Strong understanding of luxury brand positioning, premium customer expectations, and high-end retail operations.
Proven ability to achieve sales targets and develop long-term relationships with high-value clients.
Experience serving high-net-worth individuals and VIP customers is an advantage.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Strong commercial awareness, business development, and customer service capabilities.
Professional appearance, discretion, integrity, and strong brand representation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
Excellent command of written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
